title: A New Musical Movie About Neighbors Who Learn to Be Friends
summary:
What happens when two neighbors who seem really different become friends? That's the story of a new movie called "Brotherhood: A Cinematic Musical." It's about Jon, an American man, and Fabián, a man from Mexico who has been waiting for years to find out if he can stay in the U.S. They live next door to each other, and even though they come from different places, they learn to see each other as people, not labels.

The movie stars Mauricio Martínez, a famous Broadway actor, and Casey Elliott, a singer from the group GENTRI. Mauricio is from Mexico himself, so the story is very personal to him. He said, "This project is deeply personal to me. As an immigrant, this story hits very close to home right now. It's about people, about heart, and about empathy—and music is such a powerful way to communicate those things."

The movie has 13 original songs written by the director, Ross Boothe. That's a lot of singing! And before the movie comes out, the cast is going on a tour called the Love Your Neighbor tour. They'll perform songs, show scenes from the movie, and talk with people in different cities. The tour starts on August 29 in Salt Lake City and ends on October 1 in New York. Then the movie opens in select theaters on Friday, October 9.

So if you like musicals, stories about friendship, or just want to see how music can bring people together, this might be a movie for you. And remember, sometimes the best friends are right next door!
why_it_matters: This movie is a reminder that a friend who seems different from you can become someone you understand and care about, even if you come from different places.

Salt Lake City is a large city in Utah where the Love Your Neighbor tour begins, while New York is known as home to Broadway.

WHAT: A musical movie called "Brotherhood: A Cinematic Musical" about two neighbors who become friends, plus a concert tour before it opens
